For the Event_Log data path, source InsertPendingNews populates the event list but does not call Show; OpenPower receives authoritative news_items in state snapshots and EventFeedPresenter renders them on the next frame. The server-snapshot journey verifies that incoming news remains visible in the open feed without inventing an automatic panel pop-up. reference's separate pending-news priority queue and advisor callbacks are outside this route.
Authoritative refusal preserves sponsor/title/acceptances after proposal deletion and adds exact sponsor-only dispatch; foreign refusals are excluded.
Authoritative trade event delivery adds the exact contextual mail row to the already-open mailbox; this source path adds mail without forcing the window open.
A new local combat result adds its exact mail row without interrupting gameplay with a summary; clicking that row opens that battle result. Foreign combat is excluded.
F9 toggles the OpenPower diagnostic console; this does not implement reference console commands.

The production map movement request port queues a source-sized neutral-border dialog per target controller. No cancels every queued move for that country; Yes revalidates and sends ActionInvadeTerritory. Diplomacy checks ownership/controller/domain/route before authorizing hostilities; the military phase reuses normal movement. Native scenarios preserve multiple requests, independent country queues, stale state and refusal feedback.

A click on the real renderer's displaced battle label passes its hit test and exact battle ID through the GameLayout entry point also used by GameView. The participant frame dispatches owner-only force orders, presets and retreat.

A non-participant battle label opens the observer source frame with country flags and published category group totals. Missing or stale aggregates show a dash; foreign commands and private roster details remain unavailable.
A persisted treaty-proposal dispatch passes its treaty ID to the details window; the scenario asserts the selected proposal title.
The delivered refusal opens its recorded accepted/refused country report in Region_Control_Change_Window; missing reasons remain explicitly unavailable.
A persisted trade dispatch passes its deal ID to the Offers page; the scenario asserts the selected deal, rather than opening a blank proposal.
A persisted EventBattleEnded dispatch opens the source-sized summary with that battle ID, region, aggregate losses and outcome. Per-category losses unavailable in OpenPower remain unreported.
